deficits.evidence: There is a concrete wall and grass verge but no dedicated footway for pedestrians.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the right side of the road to provide safe pedestrian access.

deficits.evidence: There is high crossing demand due to the transit stop and commercial buildings, but no designated crossing facility is provided.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing or a signalised crossing to allow people to cross the road safely.

ratings.reason: The right side lacks a pedestrian footway, and building one is a standard feasible fix.
No designated crossing is visible despite the high-density environment, and installing one is feasible.
